question: What is the University of Ibadan motto and what does it mean?
reference_answer: The motto is Recte Sapere Fons, meaning 'For Knowledge and Sound Judgment'.

question: When did the Postgraduate School become a College?
reference_answer: Senate recommended it on 3 August 2018 and the Governing Council approved it on 5 October 2018, upgrading the Postgraduate School to a College.

question: What are the steps to complete my registration as a newly admitted postgraduate student?
reference_answer: Obtain 'Authority to Pay' from the Admission Office; print your invoice; pay at an authorised bank; wait for the confirmation of payment emailed to you; complete the registration form online; wait for matriculation number (if not a UI product) and hall allocation; print the forms and complete registration at your department and faculty.

question: What types of financial awards does the Postgraduate College offer?
reference_answer: Four awards: the UI Postgraduate College Scholarship Award, the Teaching and Research Assistantship Award, the Financial Aids Scheme for International Students, and the Scholarship for Postgraduate Students Living with Physical Disability.

question: What happens if I cannot complete my programme within the maximum allowed duration?
reference_answer: You will be advised to withdraw from the programme and denied further renewal of registration.

question: What are the library opening hours on weekdays during session?
reference_answer: 8.00 a.m. to 10.00 p.m. on weekdays (also 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. on Saturdays and 5 p.m. to 10 p.m. on Sundays during sessions).

question: How many postgraduate halls of residence does UI have and what are they called?
reference_answer: Three postgraduate halls: Tafawa Balewa Hall, Obafemi Awolowo Hall and Abdulsalami Abubakar Hall.

question: What is the capacity of Tafawa Balewa Hall and when was it opened?
reference_answer: It has a capacity for 207 students and was opened in 1968 as the University's first postgraduate hall of residence.

question: What is the email address of the Postgraduate College information desk?
reference_answer: informationdesk@pgcollege.ui.edu.ng

question: Who was awarded the first PhD at the University of Ibadan and in what subject?
reference_answer: Dr Sanya Dojo Onabamiro, in Zoology in 1952.
evidence: first ph d was awarded in zoology in 1952

question: What is the maximum length of a thesis abstract and how many keywords should it have?
reference_answer: Not more than 500 words, structured into four paragraphs, with a minimum of three and a maximum of five keywords.

question: What font and size should I use to type my dissertation?
reference_answer: Times New Roman, point 12 for text; titles and headings should not be more than point 14.

question: What page margins and paper size does the thesis guideline require?
reference_answer: A4 paper (not less than 80 grammes), with a 3.7 cm left margin and 2.5 cm for other margins; 5.0 cm above the heading at the top of a new chapter's first page.

question: How many chapters should a thesis or dissertation have?
reference_answer: Not less than five and not more than seven chapters.

question: What is the deadline for submitting my passed thesis for November graduation, and what must I submit?
reference_answer: The deadline is 30 September of the same year. Submit five hard copies (more with co-supervisors) bound in hard National Green cover, plus two virus-free electronic copies on compact disks, to the Postgraduate College.

question: What line spacing should I use for the main body of my thesis?
reference_answer: 1.5 line spacing for the main body; in-text quotations are single-spaced.

question: Am I allowed to use both footnotes and endnotes in my thesis?
reference_answer: No. The combined use of footnotes and endnotes is not acceptable.
evidence: combined use of footnotes and endnotes

question: Should I use British or American spelling in my thesis?
reference_answer: British spellings and punctuation are preferred; overlapping use of Americanisms is not allowed.

question: How should the pages of my thesis be numbered?
reference_answer: Consecutive Roman numerals (starting with i, not shown on the title page) for pages before the first chapter, then Arabic numerals starting from 1 for the main body, centred at the bottom of each page.

question: What colour must the bound thesis be, and what should appear on the spine?
reference_answer: Hard green cover in National Green (colour code 0-010). The title and author's name are in gold lettering on the front cover, and the spine carries the author information (degree, year and name) in gold lettering, 10-12 mm, from top to bottom.

question: How long can the acknowledgements section of a thesis be?
reference_answer: It should be concise and not exceed two pages.

question: How much are the postgraduate application forms for academic and professional programmes?
reference_answer: N13,000 for academic programmes and N18,000 for professional programmes (Master and PGD applicants pay an extra N3,000 for the English proficiency test).

question: What score do I need in the English proficiency test for Master's or Postgraduate Diploma admission?
reference_answer: At least 40%.

question: How many letters of recommendation are required for the application?
reference_answer: Three e-letters of recommendation from faculty members or others well acquainted with the applicant's academic work, submitted electronically as part of the online application.

question: Can I defer my admission offer to the following year?
reference_answer: No. The Postgraduate College does not entertain deferment; an offer not taken up in the year given lapses and the candidate may reapply the following year.

question: Can I apply to more than one department or programme at the same time?
reference_answer: No. A candidate may apply to only one department or programme.

question: Who is eligible for part-time admission?
reference_answer: Candidates who are on the academic staff of the University or who satisfy the Postgraduate College that facilities for their work as part-time students are adequate; they may be asked to show evidence of release by their employers.

question: What minimum degree class is expected of foreign applicants?
reference_answer: A bachelor's degree with at least a Second Class Upper Division from a university recognised by Senate.

question: What is admission as an occasional student?
reference_answer: Candidates who meet the minimum entry requirements and are recommended by the Faculty Postgraduate Committee may be admitted as occasional students, but they are not awarded a degree of the University of Ibadan.

question: How much is the acceptance fee for newly admitted postgraduate students?
What extra fees do foreign postgraduate students pay in USD?
reference_answer: Examination fee of $300, Postgraduate Development Fee of $400, and a $300 bench fee for laboratory-based programmes.

question: How much is the late registration penalty for Nigerian students?
What does my postgraduate tuition fee cover?
reference_answer: Registration, tuition/instruction, supervision, examinations and graduation processing, plus membership of the Kenneth Dike Library and the Students' Union.

question: According to the amended 2024/2025 calendar, when does second semester teaching run and for how many weeks?
reference_answer: 13 weeks for teaching, revision and continuous assessment from Monday 25/08/25 to Friday 21/11/25.

question: In the 2025/2026 academic calendar, when do returning students resume on campus and start online registration?
reference_answer: Thursday 05/03/26.

question: When are the first semester GES examinations in the 2025/2026 session?
reference_answer: Monday 25/05/26 to Friday 29/05/26.

question: Do postgraduate students resume at the same time as undergraduates?
reference_answer: Yes, postgraduate students resume along with the undergraduate students.
evidence: postgraduate students to resume along with the undergraduate

question: How early must I submit the request for my M.Phil/Ph.D conversion examination?
reference_answer: At least one week before the examination date, with the student's last registration form attached. An examination held without approval or at a different venue/date is null and void.
evidence: at least one week before the date of the examination

question: What is needed before approval is granted for my oral examination, and how early must the request go in?
reference_answer: All examiners' reports must be submitted before approval can be granted, and the form must be returned to the Postgraduate College at least two weeks before the proposed oral examination date.
evidence: all reports must be in before an approval

question: Is orientation compulsory for newly admitted postgraduate students?
reference_answer: Yes, orientation of newly admitted students is mandatory.
evidence: orientation of newly admitted students is mandatory

question: hi
reference_answer: A friendly greeting offering help with postgraduate questions.

reference_answer: A polite acknowledgement offering further help.

question: Who are you and what can you help me with?
reference_answer: Introduces itself as the University of Ibadan Postgraduate AI Assistant and lists topics it can help with: admissions, fees, registration, examinations, thesis guidelines, academic calendar.

question: What is the pass mark for a postgraduate course and how are marks graded?
reference_answer: The pass mark is 40%. Grades: 0-39 E (Fail), 40-49 D (Pass), 50-59 C (Good), 60-69 B (Very Good), 70-100 A (Excellent).

question: Until when can I withdraw from a course I registered for?
reference_answer: Within the first six weeks of the semester in which the course is taught, on completion of the prescribed forms from the Postgraduate College.

question: What happens if I fail a compulsory course?
reference_answer: The student must re-register for the course (or project) and be re-examined at the next opportunity.

question: Who is allowed to supervise M.Phil and Ph.D candidates?
reference_answer: Lecturers with a minimum of three years post-doctoral research/teaching experience can supervise M.Phil, M.D. and Ph.D. candidates.
evidence: minimum of three years post doctoral

question: How many candidates can an external examiner examine in one session?
reference_answer: No external examiner shall examine more than 25 candidates at any examination in a session, nor more than three areas of specialisation.

question: How many course units must a full-time academic Master's student register for?
reference_answer: A minimum of 30 units and a maximum of 45 (including the project, which carries 6 units); seminar presentation is compulsory.
evidence: minimum of 30 units and a maximum of 45

question: Who do I report a supervision or other grievance to first, and what is the escalation route?
reference_answer: Grievances go to the Departmental Postgraduate Committee, then the Faculty Postgraduate Committee, and if unresolved the Executive Committee and/or the Board of the Postgraduate College.

question: How is an allegation of research misconduct handled?
reference_answer: The Provost of the Postgraduate College sets up a committee to examine the allegation; if a prima facie case exists, it is reported through the Board of the Postgraduate College to the Students' Disciplinary Committee, otherwise the allegation is dismissed.
evidence: provost of the postgraduate college shall set up a committee

question: How do I request my academic transcript as a postgraduate student?
reference_answer: Requests are made on the prescribed forms obtainable from the College portal, and each request attracts a fee prescribed by the Postgraduate College.

question: How many units must full-time Diploma candidates register for?
reference_answer: A minimum of 24 units and a maximum of 30 units (Certificate programme candidates register for 12 to 24 units).
evidence: minimum of 24 units and a maximum of 30 units

question: What sanctions can be imposed on a student found guilty of misconduct?
reference_answer: Sanctions the University may apply include fines, disciplinary probation, suspension or rustication, expulsion, loss of privileges, and withdrawal from the programme.

question: How much is the hostel accommodation fee per session in Abdulsalami Abubakar Hall?
reference_answer: The hostel fee amount is not stated in the documents; the assistant should say it doesn't have it and must not invent a figure.

question: What is the penalty for double matriculation at the University of Ibadan?
reference_answer: The penalty is expulsion. Double matriculation means a matriculated student retakes JAMB to change to another course in the same or another institution.

question: What happens to a student who got admission with fake or irregular credentials?
reference_answer: The student is asked to withdraw from the University regardless of level and will not get another opportunity to study there.

question: Do I get a new matriculation number if I change my faculty or programme?
reference_answer: No. A student keeps the same matriculation number even if the faculty or programme of study changes.

question: I am a UI graduate starting a postgraduate programme. Which matriculation number do I register with?
reference_answer: Use your undergraduate matriculation number for registration; trying to obtain more than one matriculation number leads to disciplinary action including expulsion.

question: What sanction applies to sexual harassment by a student?
reference_answer: Reprimand, or rustication for one semester up to expulsion, depending on the gravity of the offence.

question: Can a male student change his name while at the university?
reference_answer: No. Only female students may change their names, because of a change in marital status and with acceptable documentary proof; no change of name by a male student is recognised.
evidence: no change of name by any male student

question: What sanctions can follow other examination misconduct that is not specifically listed?
reference_answer: Sanctions range from reprimand to outright expulsion, at the discretion of the Central Student Disciplinary Committee (CSDC), considering each case on its merit.

question: What must I do with my student identity card when I graduate or withdraw?
reference_answer: Surrender it to the Records Officer.
evidence: surrender their identity cards to the records officer

question: How does the gender policy describe gender violence?
reference_answer: It can take the form of sexual harassment of female and male staff and students by peers, superiors and others.
evidence: sexual harassment of female and male staff and students

question: What was the total student enrolment at the University of Ibadan in 2022/2023?
reference_answer: 36,851 students.

question: When was the University of Ibadan founded and what was it originally called?
reference_answer: Founded in 1948 as University College, Ibadan, a constituent of the University of London; it became the University of Ibadan in 1962.

question: What degrees does the Department of Statistics award at postgraduate level?
reference_answer: M.Phil, M.Phil/Ph.D, M.Sc, PGD and Ph.D.

question: Which programmes does the Department of Computer Science offer for postgraduates?
reference_answer: Master of Science in Computer Science and Master in Business Computing.
evidence: master of science in computer science

question: What fields of interest can I choose in postgraduate Statistics?
reference_answer: Examples include Time Series Analysis, Stochastic Processes, Bayesian Statistics and Decision Theory, Biometrics, Econometric Theory and Methods, and Statistical Inference.

question: Is there a Postgraduate Diploma in Statistics at the University of Ibadan?
reference_answer: Yes, the Department of Statistics offers a Postgraduate Diploma in Statistics alongside the Master of Science in Statistics.

question: What example courses are listed for postgraduate Medicine?
reference_answer: Examples include MED 701 Cardiology, MED 702 Nephrology, MED 703 Pulmonology, MED 704 Neurology, MED 705 Gastroenterology and MED 706 Endocrinology.

question: How much is the postgraduate application form for professional programmes?
reference_answer: N25,000 for professional programmes (N20,000 for academic programmes), with an extra N5,000 for the English proficiency test for Master's and PGD applicants, according to the Postgraduate College website.

question: How can I track the status of my postgraduate application?
reference_answer: Click 'Print Documents' on the application portal and select 'Application Status' to see stages such as Eligibility, Referees Report, Recommendation and Admission Letter Ready.

question: What do I need before applying for a Nigerian visa as an international postgraduate student?
reference_answer: An admission letter and a letter of introduction from the Postgraduate College; the visa application follows the procedure of the Nigerian mission in the applicant's country.

question: Are there language programmes for applicants from non-English-speaking countries?
reference_answer: Yes, language immersion programmes are available for non-English-speaking candidates.

question: Which form do I use to claim an honorarium for supervising a PhD as a retired academic?
reference_answer: The PhD Supervision by Retired Academics Honorarium Claims Form.

question: What penalties can apply to someone found to have violated the sexual harassment policy?
reference_answer: Penalties can include monitoring, counselling or therapy, oral admonition, a written warning or oral reprimand, referral to the Staff or Student Disciplinary Committee, or any other disciplinary action.

question: Is a person who reports sexual harassment protected from retaliation?
reference_answer: Yes. Victimisation of anyone who makes a complaint, or exercises their rights in good faith under the policy, is prohibited and punishable by disciplinary action.

question: Which department offers the Professional Master's in Business Computing?
reference_answer: The Department of Computer Science (Faculty of Science).

question: Which form do external examiners use to claim payment for examining higher degrees?
reference_answer: The Postgraduate College Claims Form for External Examiners for Higher Degrees.
